# Unicode CLDR data (CLDR 47, UCA 16.0.0)

Vendored for the UCA collation feature (`sxml_uca_collation_feature`,
`src/collation_uca.c`, `src/collation_tailoring.c`, packet 7.15b, D220)
and the localization feature (`sxml_localization_feature`,
`src/language_table.c`, `src/spell_out.c`, packet 7.17, D221) under D13
and D208. The release is pinned in `third_party/cldr.version`
(tag `release-47` of https://github.com/unicode-org/cldr, commit
`adbaf76bf62572cbfe2044564c40ed44beb00f8a`). sxml does not compile these
files in: hosts serve them through their resource resolver as
`SXML_RESOURCE_KIND_COLLATION_DATA` under `urn:sxml:collation-data:`, and
`SXML_RESOURCE_KIND_LOCALE_DATA` under `urn:sxml:locale-data:`, and the
path below `common/` (D184, D189, D220, D221). The QT4 and XSLT test drivers
serve this copy (`../cldr/common/` from their catalogs), and so do the
unit tests.

The subset, unchanged, is: the CLDR root collation and the collations of
the languages D208 names (en, de, fr, it, es, nl) with their regional
files; the main/ files of root, those languages and de_AT (the calendar
names; the localization feature reads ldml/dates/calendars); their rbnf/
files (the spell-out rules); and supplemental/supplementalData.xml (the
eras' dates in calendarData) and supplemental/ordinals.xml (the ordinal
plural rules):

Each file was downloaded from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unicode-org/cldr/release-47/<path>`.
Other languages work the same way when a host serves their files from a
CLDR checkout; the files of a language's regions (`fr_CA.xml`) are looked
up before the language's (`fr.xml`). The sxml command embeds these files,
the main/ ones reduced to what the localization feature reads (the months,
days, day periods and eras of the gregorian, buddhist, japanese and
islamic calendars) and supplementalData.xml to its calendarData
(`apps/sxml/embed-cldr-data.cmake`); the subsets keep CLDR's paths and
values.

`src/collation_tables.c` (the reorder groups) is generated by
`tools/generate-collation-tables.py` from `common/uca/FractionalUCA_SHORT.txt`
of the same release (SHA-256
`15bc6d75e55547bd17799e625fe835d3c3698572b32b4e12f7f00616607d35a9`), which
is not vendored: download it to regenerate.
